signin_desc: Sign in to manage your feeder.
loading_status_desc: Checking the service and your access settings before opening the feeder.
startup_status_desc: Loading the model and checking hardware can take longer after an update or a model change. YA-WAMF reports this progress as it starts.
startup_failed_desc: Startup stopped during a required check. Check the container logs for the cause.
startup_phase_detecting_hardware: Checking which hardware can run the model
startup_phase_loading_model: Loading and checking the selected bird model
startup_phase_model_unavailable: Start-up is carrying on without a bird model. Nothing will be named until you download one in Settings → Identifying birds.
status_unavailable_desc: The service may still be starting after an update or model change.
status_unavailable_auto_retry: YA-WAMF checks again automatically every five seconds.
status_unavailable_help: If it stays offline, check the container health and startup logs.
login_wrong_credentials: That username or password is not right. Check both and try again. Passwords are case sensitive.
login_rate_limited: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
login_unreachable: Could not reach YA-WAMF. Check that it is running and that this device can reach it, then try again.
login_server_error: YA-WAMF could not check your sign-in. Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, look at the container logs.

password_policy.requirements: At least 8 characters, with at least one letter and one number. No more than 72 bytes: accented and non-Latin letters take more than one.
password_policy.too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
password_policy.too_long: The password must use 72 bytes or fewer. Accented and non-Latin letters take more than one byte.
password_policy.needs_letter_and_number: The password must contain at least one letter and one number.
password_policy.required: Enter a password to turn on authentication.
